screens.audience: Primary — a working developer arriving from Hacker News, Reddit, or search, deciding in a few minutes whether Spec4 is worth installing
screens.purpose: The front page: install command and a real artifact first, then the guarantees, what a round leaves on disk, the agent table, and the reasoning — reads as documentation with a front page, not a landing page

screens.audience: Secondary — a developer who has installed Spec4 and returns to the docs via the app's Docs link to look up how a part works
screens.purpose: The docs index: install, first run, the round table, the button vocabulary, and the list of reference pages, in the identical shell and typography as the front page

screens.audience: Both — the evaluating developer who wants to see real output and the returning developer checking what a tier looks like as software
screens.purpose: Built With Spec4: the live gallery's apps and the nine rounds that planned it, as two tables and a JSON excerpt

surfaces.name: SiteNav
surfaces.output: One-line nav: two-colour wordmark (Spec blue, 4 green), version 1.5.0 in monospace, three text links; the current section carries a short green rule; identical on every page

surfaces.name: ReadingColumn
surfaces.output: A single ~70-character text column in a serif face with generous line-height; headings in the same face at a larger size; system colour scheme applied with no toggle

surfaces.name: FrontLede
surfaces.output: An h1 that is a full sentence and two paragraphs saying what Spec4 is and is not

surfaces.name: InstallCommand
surfaces.output: Two-line install command in a plain code panel (one tint, 2px radius, no syntax colour, no line numbers), followed by a version/licence line

surfaces.name: GuaranteeList
surfaces.output: Six short bold-led bullets: runs locally, code stays in the repo, keys in the browser, any model any step, any coding agent, Apache 2.0

surfaces.name: ProjectPageFigure
surfaces.output: Full-column-width figure of the app's project page on Spec4's own repository with an italic caption below

surfaces.name: ArtifactTree
surfaces.output: The .spec4/v1/ file tree in a code panel with a per-file comment naming the agent that writes it

surfaces.name: PhaseExcerpt
surfaces.output: A long Markdown excerpt of .spec4/v0/phases/phase1.md in a code panel — the thing a coding agent is handed

surfaces.name: AgentTable
surfaces.output: Four-column table — Agent, Reads, Writes, Runs — header row distinguished by weight and a rule, no fill; scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper on narrow screens

surfaces.name: ProseSections
surfaces.output: Many paragraphs under h2 headings: how a round works, what it is not, what it costs, providers and keys, where the plan can be wrong, read next

surfaces.name: SiteFooter
surfaces.output: One plain line above a rule: version, licence, source, no analytics

surfaces.name: DocsLede
surfaces.output: h1 'Spec4 docs', the one-paragraph description, and the version line

surfaces.name: DocsInstall
surfaces.output: Install from PyPI and from source, two code panels, plus the upgrade line

surfaces.name: FirstRunSteps
surfaces.output: Three-step ordered list: pick a directory, connect a provider, start the first agent

surfaces.name: RoundTable
surfaces.output: Agent / Reads / Writes table for the seven agents in a scrolling wrapper

surfaces.name: ButtonTable
surfaces.output: Button / Meaning table: Start, Continue, Modify, Needs Update, Not Ready, Required

surfaces.name: DocsPageList
inputs: links to the twelve reference pages
surfaces.output: A plain list of the docs pages — seven agents, Artifacts, Rounds, Settings — each with a one-line description

surfaces.name: ExamplesLede
surfaces.output: h1 'Built With Spec4' and the paragraph describing the gallery and its nine rounds

surfaces.name: AppsTable
surfaces.output: App / Tier / Round table of the nine gallery apps

surfaces.name: RoundsTable
surfaces.output: Round / What it planned / Agents run table for v0–v8 in a scrolling wrapper

surfaces.name: CatalogExcerpt
surfaces.output: ai_catalog.json excerpt showing recommendation and decision side by side, in a code panel

shared_layout.nav: One text line inside the reading column: wordmark 'Spec4' (Spec in the app's blue, 4 in the app's green, monospace, the only blue on the site), version '1.5.0' in monospace muted, then Docs · Examples · GitHub as plain text links; the current section is marked by a short green rule beneath the word. No fill, no pill, no icons.
shell: ColorScheme rules driven by prefers-color-scheme with paired light/dark values and no on-page control
Code panel treatment (one tint, 2px radius, horizontal scroll)
Table wrapper (horizontal scroll, header by weight and rule)
Figure treatment (full column width, italic caption)
